description: Ministry of Highways & Road Development and Petroleum Resources Development - Declare, the Andarawewa - Hambanthota National Highway to be an Expressway
reasoning: This gazette content is an order made under Section 9 of The National Thoroughfares Act, No. 40 of 2008, designating certain national highways as expressways. It is a statutory instrument and regulatory action, fitting the definition of a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5) for regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements. Although a minister's name and title are mentioned, the primary purpose is to issue a legal order, not to announce a personnel change or describe portfolio responsibilities.
